electronic_model: three Conv3x3-BatchNorm-ReLU-MaxPool blocks, widths 32/64/128; GAP; dropout 0.2; Linear(128,10), trained from scratch
electronic_normalization: per-channel train-only mean/std pooled across both domains
selection: maximum validation accuracy, then minimum validation NLL; electronic selection once, optical selection by fused output
augmentation: identical horizontal flip shared by both branches; no ColorJitter
optical_optimizer: unchanged pure_optical config: Adam 0.01, weight_decay 0, cosine to 0.001, gradient clip 1
electronic_optimizer: AdamW, cosine to 0.1*initial learning rate, gradient clip 1
